description:
This Java source file defines a final utility class 'ThingsModelFactory' that provides static factory methods for creating and initializing various object types related to the 'things' model within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating Attributes, ThingDefinitions, Features, Metadata, ThingRevisions, and various permissions and ACLs, often from JSON representations. The class enforces non-instantiation by having a private constructor and primarily serves as a centralized factory for business objects in the 'things' model.

The methods include creation, parsing, validation, and builder retrieval for a broad set of 'things'-related entities, facilitating object creation with flexible and fault-tolerant APIs. The class also manages references to external files and methods, notably including JSON handling and validation utilities, and aligns with the overall package structure indicating it's a core part of the 'model' layer of the 'things' component in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ThingsModelFactory
classes.description: A utility factory class providing static methods to create and initialize various 'things' model objects, such as Attributes, Features, Metadata, and access control entities within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: emptyAttributes
methods.description: Returns a new immutable empty Attributes instance.

methods.name: nullAttributes
methods.description: Returns a new immutable Attributes instance that represents null.

methods.name: newAttributes
methods.description: Creates new Attributes initialized with the given JsonObject or JSON string.

methods.name: newAttributesBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for Attributes, optionally initialized with a JsonObject.

methods.name: newDefinition
methods.description: Creates a new immutable ThingDefinition, parsed from a CharSequence.

methods.name: nullDefinition
methods.description: Returns an immutable instance representing a null or undefined ThingDefinition.

methods.name: newFeatureDefinitionIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a new immutable DefinitionIdentifier for features with provided namespace, name, and version.

methods.name: newFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Creates a FeatureDefinition instance from a JsonArray or JSON string.

methods.name: nullFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Returns a FeatureDefinition that represents 'null' or undefined.

methods.name: newFeatureDefinitionBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for FeatureDefinition, initialised with a given identifier or JSON array.

methods.name: emptyFeatureProperties
methods.description: Returns an empty immutable FeatureProperties instance.

methods.name: nullFeatureProperties
methods.description: Returns an immutable FeatureProperties instance representing null.

methods.name: newFeatureProperties
methods.description: Creates FeatureProperties from a JsonObject or JSON string.

methods.name: newFeaturePropertiesBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for FeatureProperties, optionally initialized with a JsonObject.

methods.name: nullFeature
methods.description: Returns a Feature instance that signifies a 'null' feature with a given ID.

methods.name: newFeature
methods.description: Creates a new Feature with specified ID, optional properties, and optional definition.

methods.name: newFeatureBuilder
methods.description: Provides builders for creating Features from scratch, from existing features, or from JSON.

methods.name: emptyFeatures
methods.description: Returns an empty Features collection.

methods.name: nullFeatures
methods.description: Returns a Features instance representing null.

methods.name: newFeatures
methods.description: Creates Features instances from Iterable, JSON object, or JSON string.

methods.name: newFeaturesBuilder
methods.description: Provides builders for Features, optionally initialized with existing features.

methods.name: validateFeaturePropertyPointer
methods.description: Validates a JsonPointer used for feature properties.

methods.name: validateJsonKeys
methods.description: Validates JSON object keys for correctness according to pattern.

methods.name: emptyMetadata
methods.description: Returns an empty Metadata instance.

methods.name: nullMetadata
methods.description: Returns a Metadata instance that represents null.

methods.name: newMetadata
methods.description: Creates new Metadata from a JsonObject or JSON string.

methods.name: newMetadataBuilder
methods.description: Creates builders for Metadata, optionally initialized with existing Metadata.

methods.name: newThingRevision
methods.description: Creates a new ThingRevision with a specified revision number.

methods.name: noPermissions

methods.name: allPermissions
methods.description: Returns a mutable Permissions object with all permissions (deprecated).

methods.name: newPermissions
methods.description: Creates Permissions objects with specified permissions (deprecated).

methods.name: newUnmodifiablePermissions
methods.description: Creates unmodifiable Permissions with specified permissions (deprecated).

methods.name: newAclEntry
methods.description: Creates ACL entries with specified subjects and permissions (deprecated).

methods.name: newAclEntry
methods.description: Creates an ACL entry from a JSON object (deprecated).

methods.name: newAclEntry
methods.description: Creates an ACL entry from subject ID and JSON permissions (deprecated).

methods.name: newAclBuilder
methods.description: Provides builder objects for ACLs (deprecated).

methods.name: newAcl
methods.description: Creates ACLs from entries or JSON, all deprecated.

methods.name: newThing
methods.description: Creates a Thing object from a JsonObject or JSON string.

methods.name: newThingBuilder
methods.description: Provides builders for creating Things, initialized from scratch, from JSON, or existing objects.
